credibility.headline: Met 1 of 5 checkable promises
credibility.line: Missed HKC display trials, HKC display mass production and inventec JV operational; short on FATL Tirupati production commencement; delivered robo vacuum cleaners production start for Eureka Forbes.

rows.label: HKC display trials
rows.reason: Trials were delayed from Q4 FY26 to Q3 FY27.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Construction of our facility for display modules in which we have a 74:26 JV with HKC for first phase underway for smartphones and notebooks with trials to be commenced from Q4 this fiscal and commencement of mass production by Q1 of next fiscal.

delivered.label: HKC display trials
delivered.quote: The trials will start from beginning of Q3 and mass production will commence from end of Q3, beginning of Q4 this fiscal.
delivered.title: Q4 FY26 earnings call

rows.label: HKC display mass production
rows.reason: Mass production was delayed from Q1 FY27 to Q3-Q4 FY27.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Construction of our facility for display modules in which we have a 74:26 JV with HKC for first phase underway for smartphones and notebooks with trials to be commenced from Q4 this fiscal and commencement of mass production by Q1 of next fiscal.

delivered.label: HKC display mass production
delivered.quote: The trials will start from beginning of Q3 and mass production will commence from end of Q3, beginning of Q4 this fiscal.
delivered.title: Q4 FY26 earnings call

rows.label: Inventec JV operational
rows.reason: Operational timeline was pushed from Q1 FY27 to Q4 FY27.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Our 60:40 JV with Inventec one of the world’s top 5 PC ODMs for manufacturing of notebook PC products, servers and desktop PCs is expected to be operational by Q1 of next fiscal.

later.speaker: Atul Lall
later.quote: It is one of the world's top five IT products, ODM, for manufacture of notebook PC products, servers, desktop PC, including its components like SSDs, memory and mechanicals in India, and is expected to be operational by Q1 of next fiscal, which will have a positive impact on the margins.

delivered.label: Inventec JV operational
delivered.quote: Our new manufacturing facility addition to our current facility in Chennai for a 60 -40 joint venture with Inventec Corporation, one of the largest top 5 ODMs in IT space is expected to get operational from Q4 of this fiscal.
delivered.title: Q1 FY27 earnings call

rows.label: FATL Tirupati production commencement
rows.reason: Mass production start pushed to Q2 FY27.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Our construction for capacity expansion for FATL in Tirupati is ready for commencement of production by end of Q3 and are in the process of ordering additional production line, launch of SAWM, that is semi-automatic washing machine, in 16 kg and 18 kg capacity, which would be the first across the industry and expected to be launched by December '25.

delivered.label: FATL Tirupati production commencement
delivered.quote: Our new Tirupati facility for front -loading washing machine is read y and mass production to start by Q2 financial year '26-'27 with annual capacity of 300,000 units.
delivered.title: Q3 FY26 earnings call

rows.label: Robo vacuum cleaners production start for Eureka Forbes
rows.reason: Production started for Eureka Forbes in Q3 FY26 as committed.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Production of robo vacuum cleaners to Eureka Forbes is to start by December '25.

delivered.label: Robo vacuum cleaners production start for Eureka Forbes
delivered.quote: Production started for robotic vacuum cleaners for Eureka Forbes with healthy order book
delivered.title: Q3 FY26 earnings call

rows.label: Mobile volume growth Q-o-Q
rows.reason: FINN found no Q2 FY26 figure for this in the later calls.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Ahead of the festive season we expect volume growth of at least 15% quarter-on-quarter.

rows.label: Noida mobile campus completion
rows.reason: Verdict withheld: reasoning didn't check out.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Construction of our 0.8 million square feet. mobile manufacturing campus is progressing well in Noida for our anchor customers with much higher capacity and is expected to be completed by March ‘26.

later.speaker: Atul Lall
later.quote: Construction of a 1 Mn square feet of mobile manufacturing campus in Noida is on track for our anchor customer with much larger capacity and same is expected to be completed by March '26.

rows.label: Refrigerator business growth
rows.reason: FINN found no FY26 figure for this in the later calls or the annual report's profit and loss statement.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: The outlook for ‘25, ‘26 is very promising with healthy order book, and we are confident of achieving 50% growth this fiscal.

rows.label: FATL Tirupati capacity expansion ready
rows.reason: Verdict withheld: reasoning didn't check out.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Our construction for capacity expansion for FATL in Tirupati will be ready by August ‘25 to meet the increased order book for our customers.

rows.label: Semi-automatic washing machine launch
rows.reason: A later call says it happened but not when; FINN can't tell whether it was on time.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Launch of semi-automatic washing machine in higher capacity categories of 16 and 18 Kg has already been done, and product will be launched by Q3 of the current fiscal.

later.speaker: Atul Lall
later.quote: Our construction for capacity expansion for FATL in Tirupati is ready for commencement of production by end of Q3 and are in the process of ordering additional production line, launch of SAWM, that is semi-automatic washing machine, in 16 kg and 18 kg capacity, which would be the first across the industry and expected to be launched by December '25.

delivered.label: Semi-automatic washing machine launch
delivered.quote: We have started manufacturing semi-auto washing machines in 16 and 18 kg capacity, which is first across the industry.
delivered.title: Q4 FY26 earnings call

rows.label: Signify JV operations commencement
rows.reason: Verdict withheld: reasoning didn't check out.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Our 50-50 JV with Signify that is Philips brand will commence operations from the first week of August ‘25 and expected to realize operating efficiencies through synergies

rows.label: Rexxam Chennai manufacturing location
rows.reason: Verdict withheld: reasoning didn't check out.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We have finalized a new manufacturing location at Chennai for meeting the increased order book for our anchor customer, which is expected to become operational by Q4 of this fiscal.

later.speaker: Atul Lall
later.quote: Our new facility in Chennai will be operational by Q4 of this fiscal.

rows.label: JV with Longcheer facility operational date
rows.reason: Verdict withheld: reasoning didn't check out.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We have received the PN3 approval for 74:26 joint venture with Longcheer and have finalized a new 400,000 square feet facility for the JV, which is expected to be operational by April '26 and PN3 appraisal process for 51:49 JV with Vivo and 74:26 JV with HKC is progressing well, and we expect the approvals in the coming weeks.

rows.label: Manufacturing start for new ODM smartphone customer
rows.reason: Later calls mention it; FINN found none that says whether it happened.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We are in active discussion with another large ODM of smartphones and the manufacturing for them should start by Q4 of FY 25-26.

rows.label: Display segment margins
rows.reason: No fixed date to check against.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: The margins in this segment will be in higher double digits.

rows.label: ECMS approvals for display modules and enclosures
rows.reason: No fixed date to check against.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We expect to receive ECMS approvals for display modules and enclosures shortly.

rows.label: PN3 approval for Vivo JV
rows.reason: No fixed date to check against.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We remain confident of getting the PN3 approval for our Vivo JV soon.

rows.label: Smartphone camera modules revenue potential in 2 to 3 years

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: And we feel confident that the volume of smartphone camera modules can increase from 40 million units and revenues by INR 2,000 crores in large financial years to 190 to 200 million units per annum with the revenue closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores and sub-10% EBITDA margins in the next two to three years.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: And we feel confident that the volume of smartphone camera modules can increase from 40 million units and revenues by INR 2,000 crores in large financial years to 190 to 200 million units per annum with the revenue closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores and sub-10% EBITDA margins in the next two to three years.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We have filed a components ECMS applications for display modules, camera module enclosures, lithium-ion batteries, optical transceiver - SFP and also mechanical enclosures with investment commitment of approximately INR 3,000 crores over the next three years.

rows.label: IT business target in next two years

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We feel that the IT business for us in next two years should be around Rs. 4,000 crores to Rs. 5,000 crores business.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We feel that for next year, the numbers are going to be somewhere around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.

revisions.speaker: Atul Lall
revisions.quote: We feel that our revenue in this fiscal is going to be more than INR4,000 crores.

later.speaker: Atul Lall
later.quote: We feel that our revenue in this fiscal is going to be more than INR4,000 crores.

rows.label: Display module JV trials and production

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: The trials will start from beginning of Q3 and mass production will commence from end of Q3, beginning of Q4 this fiscal.

later.speaker: Atul Lall
later.quote: The response from various brands is very encouraging and the trial will start from the beginning of Q3 and mass production to commence from end of Q3 and beginning of Q4 this fiscal year.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Our 400,000-square-foot facility for 74:26 Longcheer JV for manufacturing of smartphones and other electronic products is expected to start operations by Q3, which will meaningfully strengthen our execution capabilities.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Construction of our 1 million square feet facility in Noida with higher capacities for our anchor customers is nearing completion, and we expect the operation to commence by Q2 this fiscal.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We expect this vertical to deliver high double-digit revenue growth in the current fiscal.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Our new facility adjacent to our existing facility under our 60:40 JV within Inventec, Taiwan is progressing well and expected to go into mass production in Q3 of the current fiscal.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Addition of a new manufacturing facility in Tirupati will expand our capacities from 0.6 million units per annum by another 0.3 million units, including fully automatic front-loading washing machine, which will be launched by end of Q2 this financial year.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: The next year target is almost INR1,700 crores. We expect 2x after we have formed the JV with Signify.

rows.label: Q Tech camera module revenue target

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Last year, on an annualized basis, we did a revenue of INR1,700 crores. We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27. That's another major trigger of growth.

revisions.speaker: Atul Lall
revisions.quote: So, telecom revenues, please appreciate, we have grown from INR700 crores to INR 3,600 crores to INR5,000 crores and we feel, as I mentioned earlier, we're going to be somewhere between INR6,700 crores to INR7,000 crores in this fiscal.

later.speaker: Atul Lall
later.quote: So, telecom revenues, please appreciate, we have grown from INR700 crores to INR 3,600 crores to INR5,000 crores and we feel, as I mentioned earlier, we're going to be somewhere between INR6,700 crores to INR7,000 crores in this fiscal.

rows.label: Mobile revenue vs volume growth difference

promised.speaker: Saurabh Gupta
promised.quote: So we expect Pankaj to -- that the revenue growth should be at least 12% to 15% higher, if not more.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat. If Vivo comes in, then it's a very major trigger. We feel that without the Vivo also, the company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17%.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Our market position, customer engagement and manufacturing capabilities remain intact, and we expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter-on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens and we have a strong order book.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We expect the JV to commence operations and start reflecting in our revenues from Q3 of the current fiscal.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Production of complex microwave backhaul radios for large global brand has scaled up successfully, and we expect to also commence exports of these products during the current fiscal year.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Our new manufacturing facility addition to our current facility in Chennai for a 60-40 joint venture with Inventec Corporation, one of the largest top 5 ODMs in IT space is expected to get operational from Q4 of this fiscal.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Moving strategically beyond traditional end computing, and we are actively discussing with a joint venture partner to tap into the growth into the high-growth enterprise server and data center hardware ecosystem, which allows us to address a surge in cloud and AI infrastructure demand and will start manufacturing SSD from Q3 and also exploring other critical components such as power supplies and mechanicals, which will enhance value addition and margins.

rows.label: Tirupati facility expansion and fully automatic front-loading washing machine 9 launch

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Addition of our new manufacturing facility in Tirupati will expand our capacities from 0.6 million units per annum by another 0.3 million units per annum, including fully automatic front-loading washing machine 9, which will be launched in Q3 of this fiscal.

rows.label: Dishwashers and microwave ovens production start

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We have started production of robotic vacuum cleaners with healthy order book and are on track to start production of dishwashers and microwave ovens in Q3 of this fiscal.

rows.label: Lighting export deliveries to U.S. and Germany

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: We expect to start export deliveries to the largest retail chain in U.S. and Germany in Q2 and Q3 of this fiscal.

promised.speaker: Atul Lall
promised.quote: Our new facility in Chennai will be operational starting August '26 with expanded capacity to meet the demand of our anchor customer.
